title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - DataProduct
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/DataProduct. A collection of data which is packaged by a Data Provider and made ready for Data Access. Subclass of DigitalServiceOffering per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the DigitalServiceOffering model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'DataProduct'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

dataProductDescription.description: Relationship. Description of the Data Product. Links to a DataProductDescription entity.

dataRightsHolders.description: Relationship. A list of persons holding legal rights on the data contained in the Data Product. Links to one or more LegalPerson entities.
